_note: Read 17 September 2026 from prestigeone.ae. No form was filled - the site's 'Register for interest' and the /project-documents page ask for name, email and phone, and I did not touch them. Two families of image are excluded as page furniture, not project media: /assets/images/v3/amenities-sliders/... which are stock views of Dubai landmarks (Burj Khalifa, Palm Jumeirah, the airport) used as a location strip on every project page, and /assets/project-featured-images/sliders/... which are thumbnail cards advertising OTHER projects at the foot of the page. Every render on this site carries a PRESTIGE ONE watermark. G+12, 1- to 3-bedroom. I downloaded and LOOKED at the four exteriors and three interiors. FILENAME WARNINGS: 'Night - Front Side.webp' is a DAYLIGHT render under a blue sky, not a night scene; and 'Changing Room 2.webp' is not a changing room at all - it is a washroom with urinals and a vanity. The genuinely nocturnal files are 'Night - Rear Side' (dusk) and 'Seaside_Building Night' (a night aerial). No floor plans are published as images.
